title: Yielding Syrian Quinoa Stew
description: A light, grassy quinoa stew that simmers slowly to airy perfection, topped with a velvety layer of cheese.
instructions: Rinse quinoa under cold water until water runs clear.
In a large pot, combine rinsed quinoa, vegetable broth, diced tomatoes, carrots, celery, onion, garlic, oregano, cumin, salt and pepper; stir to mix.
Bring mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally.
After 25 minutes, remove pot from heat and let the quinoa stew stand, covered, for 5 minutes to develop an airy texture.
Stir in the grated cheese (or vegan cheese alternative) and allow it to melt into the stew.
Taste and adjust seasoning with extra salt or pepper if needed.
Serve hot, optionally garnished with fresh parsley or a squeeze of lemon for brightness.
